# Rakefire

> A Ruby on Rails agency and product studio. We build software for clients and ship our own SaaS — Causey and Stoked.

Rakefire is a small, senior team based in Athens, Ohio. We've run since 2011, primarily on long-term client engagements and our own products. We pick boring, durable tech (Rails, Postgres, SQLite, Hotwire) and optimize for relationships that compound over years.

Markdown versions of every page are available at `/path/index.md` (URL-suffix convention per llmstxt.org). The site also publishes structured agent skills at `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` and an API catalog at `/.well-known/api-catalog`.

## Core pages

- [Home](/index.md): A Ruby on Rails agency and product studio. The homepage is the canonical overview — work, products, and how to engage all live there.

## Our products

- [Causey](https://www.causey.app): Strategic planning software for nonprofits.
- [Stoked](https://get.stokedhq.com): Peer-to-peer brand advocacy for DTC brands.
